## Author checklist

- [ ] Scope matches the linked task.
- [ ] No secrets or real private data in source, fixtures, logs, or screenshots.
- [ ] Evidence reports what actually ran; skipped checks are not claimed as passes.
- [ ] Tests were not weakened merely to obtain green CI.
- [ ] Relevant docs/contracts/migrations are updated together.
- [ ] No unauthorized spend, publication, deployment, or access change.

Checking these boxes is not merge authorization. Trusted policy, current candidate evidence, and required owner approval control integration.
